ValidationRule.description: Prevents users to set order status related to the integration with SAP manually
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED(Status), NOT(chk_BypassValidation__c), NOT( $Permission.BypassValidations ), OR ( AND(ISPICKVAL(Status, "SentToSAP"), OR (ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Activated"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Draft"))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Status, "OrderReceivedBySAP"), OR (ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Activated"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "SentToSAP" ), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Draft")))
) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot set this status manually
